text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #146b68

g.text: Layer 1 · Stated and indexed

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182b38

g.text: A claim that one artifact states outright, so a single lookup can return it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182b38

g.text: Search engines; deep research agents.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #146b68

g.text: Layer 2 · Stated but scattered

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: A claim that no single artifact states, but whose parts are all written down across several artifacts,

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: vocabularies or formats, so answering a question means collecting and assembling them.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182b38

g.text: Deep research agents.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #146b68

g.text: Layer 3 · Unstated connection

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: A relationship between artifacts, or encoded in a model trained on them, that no record states. Each side is on

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: the record, the link between them is not, and the finding is the link itself: that A bears on B.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182b38

g.text: LIA.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #146b68

g.text: Layer 4 · Unstated implication

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: A claim, hypothesis, opportunity or question that goes beyond the link, which no artifact contains and which

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: follows only once such connections are made. This includes questions nobody has asked.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182b38

g.text: LIA.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182b38

g.text: Four layers of latent information

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #586873

g.text: How far a finding is from being stated

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: Google largely operates in the first layer. Layers measure distance from being stated, not evidence strength or validation.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #182b38

g.text: Schematic areas are not measured quantities.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #586873

g.text: Sources: chapter II-02
